learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how to use the magical apostrophe ('s) to show that something belongs to someone!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When one person or thing owns something, we add an apostrophe and an s ('s) at the end. Example: The bag of the boy becomes 'The boy's bag'.
If the word is already a plural ending in 's' (like boys), we just add the magic apostrophe AFTER the s ('). Example: The school of the boys becomes 'The boys' school'.
Some plurals do not end in 's', like children or men. For these, we use the normal 's trick! Example: The park for children becomes 'The children's park'.

fun_activity.title: 🪄 The Apostrophe Magic Trick
fun_activity.instructions: Change these phrases using magic: The toy of the baby, The house of the girls, The food of the dogs. Write the magic answers down!

quick_recap: ⭐ The apostrophe ('s) shows that someone owns something.
⭐ Add 's to singular nouns and irregular plurals (like men's).
⭐ For regular plurals ending in s, just add the apostrophe at the very end (s').
